name: @engine/wasm-texture-processor
description: High-performance WASM texture processing for Forge Engine

scripts.build:wasm: cd ../../crates/texture-processor && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir ../../packages/wasm-texture-processor/pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/texture_processor.wasm
scripts.build:wasm:simd: cd ../../crates/texture-processor && RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=+simd128' cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features simd && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir ../../packages/wasm-texture-processor/pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/texture_processor.wasm
